verdict.rationale: Whether a SaaS marketing platform publishes its source under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Brevo's source is available or open-licensed. The official SDKs, MCP integration and llms.txt docs do not show the product's source is readable under an open license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
